answer: A haven for honest agents survives only when every identity pays a graduated compute toll. (1) Each epoch an identity must submit proof of useful work, proportional to the rewards it claims. (2) The toll doubles for identities younger than 90 days. (3) Random peer auditors re-run a sample of the work; fake proofs burn the escrowed stake instantly. Fielding 1,000 sybils means 1,000 machines doing real work at $0.80 a day each — $800 daily — like watering a fake oasis in the desert: the sand drinks the water and leaves no crops. Attackers pay rent on every relic they forge.
